call_purpose: You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page, send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and add GST to your prices.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you added the yearly price, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout.
Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option and saved it, and you confirmed that a test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.

covered.text: We showed you how to add a second price: open the product, go to Pricing and click Add price.
We showed you where to set the redirect: the product's Pages settings, under the After purchase redirect option.
We discussed adding GST to your prices and pointed you to a tax setting for it.

customer_next_steps.text: Add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer.

support_next_steps.text: We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

analysis_gaps.missing: Where the tax setting is located is not in the analysis, so the summary only says one exists.
